$comment: USD per 1M tokens, keyed by provider/model. Only prices read from the provider's official pricing page, with that page as source and the date it was read as as_of. A model with no entry is unpriced (cost_micros = null). cache_write is the 5-minute cache write rate and cache_write_1h the 1-hour rate, used when the response reports 1-hour writes separately. tiers apply when the prompt (all input tokens, cache reads and writes included) is above above_prompt_tokens. DeepSeek prices are the peak rates, an upper bound: off-peak is half. Anthropic models retired on the Claude API (Opus 4.1, Opus 4, Sonnet 4) are not priced: requests to them fail. changes lists announced price changes, each applying from 00:00 UTC on its from day; the request time picks the rates. service_tiers lists the rates for a service tier the provider bills differently (priority, flex), either as a multiplier of the model's rates or as full rates. The tier is read from the response.
